stdinScript:
set -eu
printf 'HOST='; hostname
printf 'USER='; id -un
printf 'UID='; id -u
sudo -n true
printf 'SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=PASS\n'
printf '\nLISTENER\n'
sudo -n ss -lntp 'sport = :1023'
printf '\nPROCESS\n'
pgrep -a -x dropbear
for pid in $(pgrep -x dropbear); do
  printf 'EXE='; sudo -n readlink /proc/$pid/exe
  exe=$(sudo -n readlink /proc/$pid/exe)
  printf 'DEPENDENCIES\n'; ldd "$exe"
done
printf '\nUNITS\n'
systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend '*dropbear*'
for unit in $(systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend '*dropbear*' | awk '{print $1}'); do
  systemctl show "$unit" --property=Id --property=ActiveState --property=SubState --property=MainPID --property=ExecStart --property=RuntimeMaxUSec --property=FragmentPath
  systemctl cat "$unit"
done
